Discover Columbus

Columbus is a city that surprises—in the best way. Here, you'll find world-class arts and music, iconic sports traditions, and food that’s as diverse as the people who call it home. Families can spark curiosity at museums and parks, while night owls dance through districts filled with local music. Columbus invites you to experience the perfect blend of energy, creativity, and Midwest warmth.

Discover More
WHAT TO EXPECT
Plan and Prepare for your Stay

RiverCity Grille

Savor classic comfort with a modern twist at our restaurant near CMH Airport. Enjoy breakfast, salads, burgers, flatbreads, and signature entrées like tuna bowls and New York strip steak. Indulge in decadent desserts, all served with warm hospitality.

Explore
Mobile Order Room Service

Mobile-order room service from RiverCity Grille, available daily from 6 AM to 11 PM. Savor breakfast classics, fresh salads, hearty entrées, and signature flatbreads—all delivered straight to your room with just a few taps on your device.

Explore
M Club Lounge

Enjoy 24/7 M Club Lounge access with snacks, non-alcoholic drinks, Starbucks® coffee, deluxe continental breakfast, and evening bites. Book an M Club room for access. $35 fee for others; free for Platinum/Titanium, and Ambassador members and 1 guest.

Explore
RiverCity Grille Lounge

Unwind at the RCG bar with craft cocktails, local brews, and fine wines. Pair your drink with shareable bites like calamari and soft pretzels, or savor hearty favorites like burgers and flatbreads. Relax in a welcoming atmosphere perfect for any occasion.
